coverage_note: Lesson = 30 min AI/method talk + the bast/anbasat verb drill. English-only stretches: 13:25-20:30 (AI tooling talk, no Arabic from him), 22:49-25:00 beekeeper at the door (a third person's English lines are labelled Amal/Medi), 45:39-50:30 mostly English (Renata on the phone). Latin-transliterated Arabic stretches: 12:27-13:20, 20:31-30:00, 36:37-42:59, 45:12-1:00:37 (most of the conjugation drill is in Latin; his forms are often engine-mangled: 'biscuit' = بنبسط, 'button visit' = بتنبسط, 'been visit' = بينبسط, 'In beastie' = انبسطي, 'embaixoet' = انبسطت). Speaker labels: 36:05 '?: بساتِتك. بَسْتَكْ.' is Amal; 52:24-52:27 are swapped (Amal said 'No, that's sah'); many '?' lines are continuations of the previous speaker. echo: 'Babysit.' (31:07, Amal) = ببسط; 'Investii' (59:45, Medi) = انبسطي; 'bihna binkhales al-asal' (25:05) = بحب العسل (her echo 'Bihteb asal?'); 'Luka. Software luka.' (00:59) = لغة; 'Qwaad' (07:34) = قواعد; 'Bas, il, wait, el wajib' (12:27) is his Latin Arabic (بس الواجب). Not written as slips: 00:13 عمام = تمام (engine); 04:47 Spanish -> إسباني self-fix; 05:28 أكتب -> 05:32 احكي self-fix; 07:45 دورة self-rejected ('no that's your turn'); 09:42 'ذكي؟' confirm question; 09:46 'لما الـ سؤال ما عنده جواب' Amal said صحيح then rephrased with يكون (valid, re-phrase only); 28:29 and 28:56 'Kam marra?' = kaman marra (again?) - she repeats herself; 29:35 beset/besat, 30:35 بسّتني/بسطني, 51:37 inbashatat, 55:22 'you stressed on the T' = pronunciation (S4/F2); 51:42 hume imbestu -> imbasatu self-fixed before her word; 56:04 'ban sebet'/'bansabet' for بنبسط = root-letter swap (S4, brief example); 44:55 'go have fun with them' never attempted in Arabic; 50:43 nabasit/nabasat and 59:21 'in basit?' are questions about the form; 1:01:32 'إلي right? No' question answered no illi; 36:54 ابسطه question about the a- variant. English words not on her sheet (not tier 3): nerd, software, research, test, tips, grammar (asked -> row), possibility, computer program, AI, Quizlet.

rows.medi_said: للـ اليوم nerd أن الـ الـ اللغة الـ software لقة. ... How do you say languages in it? Loka, lokat?
rows.why: He tried 'لقة' for language, she did not follow (كيف؟), he asked 'how do you say languages' and she supplied لُغَة - a didn't-know; his q-for-gh is a sound slip (S4), not vocab.

rows.medi_said: أنا لقيت الطريق منيح كتير

rows.medi_said: أنا لقيت الطريق منيح كتير

rows.medi_said: To learn would be أتأل-- or يتعلّم or-

rows.medi_said: Okay. أتعلم لغة جديد
